name: azure-arm-cosmosdb-dotnet-environment
description: An Azure Resource Manager .NET SDK runtime for Cosmos DB management-plane provisioning with ARM write permission.

tools.create_account: Creates a Cosmos DB account through ARM when arm_write is granted; adds account_exists.
tools.create_database: Creates a SQL database in an existing Cosmos DB account when arm_write is granted; adds database_exists.
tools.create_container: Creates a SQL container in an existing Cosmos DB SQL database when arm_write is granted; adds container_exists.
tools.get_connection_strings: Reads connection strings from an existing Cosmos DB account; adds connection_strings_read.

lacks: Importing an existing account is unavailable.
